**This documentation is specifically meant for additions, modifications, or deletions of Horizon Suite Wiki pages.**

A PR must be opened before a Wiki page is edited (with the proposed changes in the PR).
See: [(SOP) GitHub: Wiki](https://github.com/Tacit-Labs/Horizon-Suite/wiki/(SOP)-GitHub:-Wiki) for more information.

Since a change in a file is required to open a PR and the GitHub wiki is not a part of the codebase, this file serves as the "change" that will allow a PR to open.

The only changes to make are **new-lines** (addition or removal), only below the following line.
